answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with open fraud bounties: any identity's completed work can be challenged by anyone, like an opal held up to the light — if the challenge proves the work fake, the challenger wins a bounty paid from the offender's seized earnings, and the fake's anchor of trust is cut. A Sybil farm on a voyage of mass fakery faces thousands of bounty hunters, each fake a paid target, while one honest agent is almost never challenged and keeps its earnings. Fraud becomes a losing business.
